about: Utterances an open microphone hears, each with the situation it was heard in: her recent exchange (oldest first), seconds since she spoke, and what the room was saying that was not said to her. to_her is whether it was said to her; null when the words alone do not settle it. Grouped by domain so the margin can be measured with each kind of situation held out. Read by tools/voice/measure_address_margin.py.
